key_insights.title: Author Claim
key_insights.body: MOF 1 remains crystalline after N2 adsorption and after vapor-phase adsorption of n-hexane, 3-methylpentane, and 2,2-dimethylbutane, as PXRD matches simulated data.

key_insights.title: Author Claim
key_insights.body: Hexane isomer separation on a column packed with 1 at 50 °C gives residence times of ~1.9 min for 22DMB, ~2.9 min for 3MP, and ~3.5 min for n-HEX.

notable_quotes: MOF 1 remains crystalline after N2 adsorption and after vapor-phase adsorption of n-hexane, 3-methylpentane, and 2,2-dimethylbutane, as PXRD matches simulated data.
Hexane isomer separation on a column packed with 1 at 50 °C gives residence times of ~1.9 min for 22DMB, ~2.9 min for 3MP, and ~3.5 min for n-HEX.
Separation efficiency is uneven: 22DMB shows 0 efficiency, while 3MP and n-HEX show efficiencies of 1.4 and 0.6, respectively.
